heading: Calls must be accounted for
text:
### Calls must be accounted for [LTSL.7.6]

Every outbound call a program makes during the run must match some `for call` entry
— a reply, an `after` reply, or `no response`. The runtime must fail the test case
on an **unaccounted** outbound call ([RTIM]); it must not treat one as a silent
no-op. This keeps a timeout test honest.
